claim_ceiling: This synthetic generator regression distinguishes its known hard routes under this probe set and predicts same-generator challenges. It is not evidence that natural-language residuals identify a mechanism in a natural model.
estimand: hard-routed synthetic reliance regime; not a natural-model hidden trace
input_contract: prompt_and_output_text_only; no logprobs, latency, usage, or model ID features
phase_sealing: same-process prediction-lock simulation; file order is hashed but evaluation blindness is not capability-separated

prospective_heldout_challenges.unit_note: challenge trials are nested within synthetic targets from one generator; neither trials nor target replicates are independent model samples
